reports.title: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. Reports Results for Fiscal Second Quarter 2027

guidance.heading: Outlook for Fiscal Year 2027
section: Take-Two is updating its outlook for the fiscal year and providing its initial outlook for its fiscal third quarter ending December 31, 2026:

desk.headline: Revenue down 16% to $1.5bn, below estimates; smaller loss; FY27 net bookings outlook of $8.0–8.2bn reaffirmed ahead of GTA VI
results: Net bookings fell 18% to $1.60bn, a little under the company's own $1.62–1.67bn forecast, as NBA 2K27 started slower than hoped.
GAAP revenue fell 16% to $1.50bn, below the $1.66bn analysts expected.
The net loss narrowed to $54m ($0.29 a share) from $134m, helped by lower costs and a tax benefit; the loss was smaller than forecast.
Spending on in-game purchases and other recurring items fell 9% and made up 81% of bookings.
First-half operating cash flow was -$174m, against +$84m a year earlier.

guidance.summary: Take-Two kept its full-year net bookings target of $8.0–8.2bn and gave its first Q3 outlook, which includes the 19 Nov launch of GTA VI. Other full-year lines were updated, but the release does not show the earlier ranges.

points: GTA VI launches on 19 Nov; management said pre-orders are running far above its own early expectations.
Management chose not to raise the forecast before launch, saying it does not count success before it happens.
NBA 2K27 sold over 4 million units but missed internal plans; more in-game content is meant to lift the second half.
Selling mobile games directly to players is growing and saves app-store fees, which helps margins.
No fiscal 2028 guidance yet; the CFO expects operating cash flow above $1bn and a net cash position by year-end.
call.source: Call coverage: MarketBeat via Yahoo Finance, 9 Nov 2026; The Motley Fool, 10 Nov 2026; Inven Global, 9 Nov 2026

watch: GTA VI launch sales and whether management lifts the outlook once results are in.
Whether NBA 2K27 bookings pick up in the second half as promised.
Delivery of the $1bn-plus operating cash flow and a net cash position by March 2027.
